internal_ball_in.note: Exact X220 internal ball: every vertex of the supplied set is reached from the supplied vertex by a walk of at most r edges (size p) whose listed vertices all lie in the set. Vacuous on the empty set; it does not assert centre membership, which nonemptiness forces. No graph_dist, truncation or host distance.

internal_shallow_minor.note: Exact X220 internal-radius model: supplied B : H -> {set G} and ctr : H -> G with upstream minor_rmap on the same B, ctr x in B x as a separate clause, and internal balls of radius r. Proved equivalent on the same maps to centre membership, internal balls, pairwise disjointness and edge realization. Empty pattern allowed; no inducedness, covering or ambient-radius condition.
